definitions.explanation: A Japanese form of massage in which the practitioner applies pressure with the fingers, thumbs, and palms to specific points on the body. Often used to relieve muscle stiffness ({肩|かた}こり) and fatigue. Sometimes paired with する as a verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{指圧|しあつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my shoulders massaged with shiatsu.

examples.japanese: {指圧|しあつ}{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: To have a shiatsu therapist treat my lower back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デスク→デスク：23405_desuku⟧ワーク⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{凝|こ}り{固|かた}まった⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、{指圧|しあつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ほぐして→ほぐす：10496_hogusu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my shoulders, stiffened from long hours of desk work, carefully loosened with shiatsu.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧/{指|し} ("finger") + {圧|あつ} ("pressure"). A traditional Japanese therapeutic practice that draws on Chinese medicine theory of meridians and pressure points but developed into a recognized profession in early-20th-century Japan. Practitioners are licensed nationally as あん{摩|ま}⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧{指圧|しあつ}{師|し}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指圧|しあつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a shiatsu massage
- {指圧|しあつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a shiatsu treatment
- {指圧|しあつ}{師|し}: shiatsu practitioner
- {指圧|しあつ}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: shiatsu therapy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧: massage — generic term; includes shiatsu, oil massage, etc.
- ⟦{整体|せいたい}→整体：27407_seitai⟧: chiropractic-like body adjustment — focuses on skeletal alignment
- {鍼灸|しんきゅう}: acupuncture and moxibustion — uses needles and heat, not pressure
